instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
juice of 1 ½ lemon
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: Peel, medium dice, and add onion to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry tomatoes, cucumbers, and bell peppers. Medium dice tomatoes and cucumbers and add to bowl with chickpeas. Seed, medium dice, and add peppers to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumber
3 yellow bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Halve olives and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place salad in a bowl or on a plate. Enjoy!
This recipe will make about 12 cups. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger; place in a blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Peel the bananas, break into chunks, and add to the blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 bananas

instructions.primary_message: Add pumpkin purée, almond milk, almonds, maple syrup, spices, and 12 ice cubes to the blender.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (15 oz) cans pure pumpkin purée
36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) almond milk, unsweetened
1 ½ cups almonds, sliced
⅓ cup pure maple syrup
1 tbsp cinnamon, ground
1 ½ tsp nutmeg, ground
¾ tsp cardamom, ground
¾ tsp cloves, ground

instructions.primary_message: Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into glasses. Top with a sprinkle of cinnamon and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry; transfer to a large bowl. Add oil and spices to the bowl and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer chickpeas to a large baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until crispy, 20-25 minutes. Reserve bowl for later use.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 leeks
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery
1 ½ bunches kale
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim off the root ends and the dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ½-inch half-moons; transfer to the large bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots into ¼-inch rounds. Trim celery and slice crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Transfer both to the bowl with the leeks.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks, carrots, celery, and spices to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables begin to soften slightly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic, broth, tomatoes, and quinoa to the pot and stir to combine; increase the heat to high and bring the liquid to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce the heat to medium-low, cover the pot with a lid, and cook for 7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
96 fl oz (12 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
1 ½ cups quinoa

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add kale to the pot and cook until kale is soft and quinoa is cooked through, about 7 more minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls. Top each bowl with a pile of crispy chickpeas; garnish with parsley and crushed red pepper. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook until the lentils are tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup red lentils
3 cup water
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. Add oil to the pot and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add onions and garlic; sauté, until onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and slice the mushrooms.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Add mushrooms and salt to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-10 minutes, until the liquid released by the mushrooms has mostly cooked off.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes and their juices, tomato paste, oregano, and thyme; stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 3-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
12 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp oregano
1 ½ tsp thyme

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small pkgs fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Stir the lentils and basil into the sauce and continue to simmer.
Wash zucchini, trim ends, and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Use paper towel or a clean dish cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the zucchini noodles.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide noodles between plates; top with the hot sauce to warm the noodles. Sprinkle with pine nuts and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F and position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
3 lemons
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus, then cut in half crosswise. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.

Place the pitas on a flat surface. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut each pita in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into 2-inch pieces and place on a separate large baking sheet pan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 whole grain pitas

instructions.primary_message: Grate zest from the lemons and transfer to a small bowl. Add oil and spices to the bowl and whisk to combine the herb oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp thyme
¾ tsp basil
¾ tsp oregano

instructions.primary_message: Spoon the herb oil over the asparagus and pita. Toss the asparagus and pita with your hands, then spread out in an even layer.

Place the asparagus on the upper rack of the oven and the pita on the rack below. Bake, tossing halfway through, until the asparagus is cooked through and pita chips are crisp, 7-9 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse the beans. Measure out a ¾ cup of beans and set aside in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: Peel the garlic. Add garlic and remaining beans to a blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the lemons into the blender. Add water, oil, tahini, and spices, then blend on high for several minutes until smooth. Add more water, one tbsp at a time, if needed, to reach desired consistency. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup water
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp tahini
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp cumin
⅜ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Juice remaining lemons into a medium bowl. Add maple syrup and spices to the bowl and whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp pure maple syrup
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp cumin
3 pinch cinnamon
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim carrot; using a box grater, coarsely grate the carrot and place in the bowl with the lemon dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
Trim cucumbers and slice crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces at an angle.
Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

To serve, divide hummus between bowls or plates; garnish with reserved beans and drizzle with oil. Arrange the asparagus, pita chips, carrot salad, sliced cucumber, and peppers around the hummus. Sprinkle parsley over top and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
6 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice potatoes. Transfer to a large pot, add salt, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and grate or mince the ginger. Transfer half of the ginger to a blender; place the other half in a small bowl.

Quarter the jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeños with a spoon. Finely dice; add half to the blender and half to the small bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Juice lemons into the blender.

Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add cilantro to the blender, along with coconut, water, salt, chili powder, and sugar. Blend on high until smooth and creamy. Transfer cilantro chutney to a small bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup shredded unsweetened coconut
⅓ cup water
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the onions.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add reserved ginger, jalapeño, and onion to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until softened, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add cooked potatoes, water, Dijon, and spices to the skillet; mash with a fork or potato masher, leaving some small pieces whole.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup water
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp turmeric
1 ½ tsp cumin
¾ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Add edamame, and cook, stirring often, until edamame are tender and potatoes are soft and fragrant, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Toast pita if desired, then slice in half and carefully open using your fingers. Fill each pita with an equal portion of the potato filling.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain pitas

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide spiced potato pockets between plates. Enjoy with cilantro chutney on the side!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 tomatoes
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice the carrots and onions; place both in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem of the cauliflower heads, then roughly chop it into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the carrot and onion.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince or grate the ginger; peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely chop the tomatoes.
Once the veggies are soft, add the ginger, garlic, and tomato to the pot. Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in broth, water, lentils, and spices. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until lentils are tender, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
6 cup water
1 ½ cup red lentils
1 tbsp cumin
¾ tsp cayenne pepper
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Using an immersion (hand) blender, process the soup until smooth. Alternatively, transfer soup to a regular blender and blend on high until smooth.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and top with avocado. Enjoy!
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ribeye steak
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and quarter lettuce lengthwise. Rub cut sides with a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 heads romaine lettuce
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak on grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Place lettuce quarters, cut side down, on grill/skillet. Cook until charred and leaves begin to wilt, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

Peel and mince garlic. In a small saucepan, combine vinegar and garlic; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to low. Stirring occasionally, simmer until liquid is reduced and thickened, 5-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ cup balsamic vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Wash, trim stem ends, and slice strawberries. Wash blueberries.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (16 oz) pkg strawberries
3 (6 oz) pkg blueberries

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop walnuts.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, place lettuce cut side up on a plate and top with berries and steak slices. Sprinkle with walnuts and drizzle with balsamic reduction. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and halve Brussels sprouts; transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb Brussels sprouts

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle sprouts with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until sprouts are starting to soften, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, peel, and chop the potatoes into ½-inch cubes. Add to the pot and cook until very tender, 7-10 minutes. Drain and return to pot.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 medium red potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, combine oil, Dijon, mayo, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tbsp vegan mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice sausages into ½-inch-thick rounds. When the Brussels sprouts are starting to soften, add sausage to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and continue to roast until the sprouts are soft and sausages are warmed through, 5-7 minutes more. (Or cook sausages according to package directions.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pre-cooked vegan sausage
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add milk, oil, salt, and pepper to potatoes and mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fl oz (¾ cup) almond milk, unsweetened
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide potatoes between bowls, top with Brussels sprouts and sausages; drizzle with creamy Dijon dressing and enjoy!
Place salt and water in a large pot, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pinch salt
5 ¼ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once boiling, add oats, cocoa powder, and maple syrup; whisk to combine. Cover and let simmer, on low, 3-5 minutes, or until oats reach desired consistency.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cup oats, quick cooking
⅓ cup cocoa powder
¼ cup pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, trim, and thinly slice strawberries.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (16 oz) pkg strawberries

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide oats between bowls and top with strawberries, almonds, and milk. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups almonds, sliced
24 fl oz (3 cups) almond milk, unsweetened

instructions.primary_message: Place milk and salt in a large pot, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
42 fl oz (5 ¼ cups) almond milk, unsweetened
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Once boiling, stir in oats and maple syrup. Cover and let simmer, on low, 3-5 minutes, or until oats reach desired consistency.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cup oats, quick cooking
2 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, halve and pit peaches, then medium dice.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 peaches

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop pecans.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup pecans, dry roasted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide oats between bowls and top with peaches, pecans, and maple syrup. Serve with milk and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) almond milk, unsweetened

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
3 lemons
3 avocados
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice the carrots at an angle.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the carrots and cook until fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water and set aside.
Meanwhile, zest half of the lemons into a large bowl, then juice all the lemons into the same bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add oil and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the shallots; add to the bowl, stirring to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ shallots

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocados; cut the flesh into cubes while still in the skin and scoop out into the bowl.
Roughly chop the pistachios and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup pistachios, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the beans in the colander with the carrots, then add both to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide spinach between plates and top with vegetable-bean salad. Enjoy!
In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
9 tomatoes
3 red bell peppers
3 medium zucchini squash
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Trim ends and medium dice eggplants. Transfer to a medium bowl, add salt, and toss to coat; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tomatoes and place in a large bowl.
Seed and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Trim ends and medium dice zucchini; add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add onion and garlic. Stirring frequently, cook until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.

Using a clean towel or paper towel, squeeze the eggplant to release excess moisture. Add eggplant to the pot along with the chopped veggies, corn, tomato sauce, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, 15-17 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups frozen corn
6 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add quinoa and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the risotto between bowls and garnish with basil. Enjoy!
Wash and cut cauliflower heads into quarters, then trim off and discard leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium heads cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Place cauliflower, broth, polenta, and salt in a large pot. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium-low; cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the mixture has thickened, 20-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
40 fl oz (5 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ cup polenta (cornmeal)
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place tomato sauce, ketchup, Dijon, sugar, vinegar, and spices in a medium saucepan. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
3 tbsp ketchup
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and medium dice zucchini.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice sausage into ½-inch rounds.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 pre-cooked vegan sausage

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini, sausage, and corn to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft and sausage is lightly browned, 5-7 minutes (or cook sausages according to package instructions).
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Pour the sauce into the skillet and toss to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower grits between plates or bowls. Top with vegetables and sausage. Enjoy!
Peel and slice half the onions into thin half-rings. Small dice remaining onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Place sliced onion in a small bowl along with vinegar and salt. Toss to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup white wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat. Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add diced onion and garlic to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until onion begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Rinse lentils under cold water and add to the pan along with the broth. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup red lentils
36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ small bunches fresh dill
1 (5 oz) pkg baby arugula
1 ½ English cucumbers
6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add olive oil and salt; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop arugula and add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumbers and tomatoes; add to the bowl.
Halve olives and add to bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Once lentils are done, drain off excess liquid and return to pan. Add paprika and salt; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide tortillas between plates and fill with lentils. Top with salad and pickled onions. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 12 small flour tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp salt
15 oz rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 English cucumbers
3 small pkgs fresh basil
3 small pkgs chives

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl.
Add mayo, pine nuts, salt, and pepper to the bowl; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup vegan mayonnaise
⅓ cup pine nuts
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces; add to the bowl.
Add corn to the pot with the pasta during the last 3 minutes of cooking.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta and corn are done, drain and rinse under cold water; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between bowls and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the center.
Wash asparagus and snap off woody ends. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 small bunches asparagus

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Sprinkle over the asparagus.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle asparagus with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place salmon in the middle of the sheet, moving asparagus to the sides. Rub salmon with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb salmon fillet
3 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and roast until salmon is opaque and asparagus is tender, 10-12 minutes.
Cut 1 ½ lemon into wedges.

instructions.primary_message: Once tips have been removed, add more oil to the pot followed by asparagus stalks, shallots, and garlic. Season with salt and pepper. Increase heat to medium-high and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the spinach; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Wash the tomatoes. Peel and mince the remaining garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ pint grape tomatoes
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add oil to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the asparagus and mix. Pour in the broth and bring to a boil. Turn heat off and purée with a hand (immersion) blender or transfer to a regular blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Add olive oil and garlic to the skillet; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Reduce heat to low. Add the tomatoes and vinegar; cook, stirring frequently, until the vinegar has thickened slightly and the tomatoes have begun to burst, 4-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
9 tbsp balsamic vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken on an angle into bite-sized strips.
To serve, pour soup into a bowl, scatter the asparagus tips over top, and season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Place chicken slices on the side and top with tomatoes. Enjoy!
In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oranges
3 (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
3 avocados
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (6 oz) pkgs raspberries

instructions.primary_message: Peel oranges, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Place in a large bowl along with the spinach.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the orange and spinach.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems. Roll half of the basil leaves up crosswise, thinly slice into ribbons, and add to the bowl. Place remaining (whole) basil leaves in a blender.

Add half of the raspberries to the bowl and set aside. Add remaining raspberries to the blender with the basil along with oil, vinegar, water, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth, then set dressing aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup red wine vinegar
¼ cup water
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the cooked quinoa to a large baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop pecans.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup pecan halves

instructions.primary_message: Once the quinoa is cool, add to the bowl, along with the pecans, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!

Wash the carrots and celery. Trim ends, peel, and small dice the carrots. Trim ends and small dice the celery. Peel and mince the onion. Peel and mince the garlic. Alternatively, place the vegetables in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 ½ medium yellow onion
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add all the diced and minced vegetables. Cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Push the veggie mixture to the side of the skillet, then add in the ground beef. Cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until beef is browned and no longer pink.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: Add diced tomatoes and tomato sauce to the beef and veggie mixture. Season with crushed red pepper, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to medium-low and let simmer for 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the basil; pick the leaves off the stems and slice into ribbons. Add about ½ to the sauce towards the end of cooking time and save the rest for garnishing.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry zucchini; trim ends. Using a julienne peeler (or regular peeler), peel zucchini into noodle-like sticks. Leave raw or warm up in a skillet with a little olive until slightly softened.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange zucchini noodles in a bowl and top with the bolognese sauce. Sprinkle with remaining basil ribbons and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into bite-sized pieces. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 small bunches asparagus

instructions.primary_message: Add riced cauliflower and corn to the baking sheets with the asparagus; drizzle with oil and sprinkle with Cajun seasoning. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (12 oz) bags frozen, riced cauliflower
4 ½ cups frozen corn
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp Cajun seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are starting to soften, about 15 minutes.
When the veggies are soft, remove from the oven and stir. Return baking sheets to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are tender and golden, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add sausages and grill, turning occasionally, until charred and warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove to a plate and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pre-cooked vegan sausage

instructions.primary_message: While the sausages are cooking, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add parsley and salsa to the baking sheets, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 cup salsa

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the cauliflower rice bake and sausages between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 small bunches cilantro
3 limes
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a large bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add half to the bowl with the cauliflower. (Place remaining onions on a plate and set aside.)
Add oil and spices to the bowl, then stir to combine. Divide cauliflower rice between two baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until rice is tender and golden, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place half in the reserved bowl. (Add remaining cilantro to the plate with the onions.)
Juice half of the limes into the bowl with the cilantro. Cut remaining limes into wedges and add to the plate.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, drain and rinse beans in a colander.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans black beans

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beans, corn, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until beans and corn are warmed through and spices are fragrant, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 cups frozen corn
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Slice crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the plate.
When the cauliflower is done, remove from the oven. Add lime and cilantro mixture, then stir to combine.
Divide cauliflower rice between bowls; top with spicy bean sauté, reserved cilantro, green onions, and avocado. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
6 tomatoes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes
3 mangoes
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic and set aside.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until beginning to soften, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: When the onion is soft, add ginger, garlic, tomatoes, and spices to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tomato is soft, about 6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp garam masala
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl (setting aside a small handful for serving).
Juice limes into the bowl with the cilantro. Add oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans in a colander. When the tomato is soft, add beans and water to the pot; stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until curry has thickened, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (15 oz) cans kidney beans
2 ¼ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; medium dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice the cucumbers. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
To serve, divide rice, curry, and salad between plates or bowls; top curry with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
15 oz rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place hummus, milk, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, remove sauce from heat, cover with a lid to keep warm, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups hummus
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) almond milk, unsweetened
⅓ cup nutritional yeast flakes
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce is heating, drain and roughly chop roasted peppers and olives. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (12 oz) jars roasted red bell peppers
1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the peppers and olives, then set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is almost done, add kale to the pot and stir to combine. Continue to cook until pasta and kale are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (10 oz) bags kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta and kale in a colander. Return to the pot along with the sauce, peppers, olives, and basil; gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.

Wash, peel, and medium dice the sweet potatoes; add to the saucepan. Once the water is boiling, cook until the potatoes are very tender when pierced with a fork, 10-15 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash the snap peas and lemons. Cut the lemons into wedges. Peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
1 ½ lemon
9 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Melt coconut oil in the skillet. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add more coconut oil to the skillet, followed by the sugar snap peas. Cook, stirring occasionally, until bright green and tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the remaining coconut oil to the potatoes and season with salt and pepper. Mash with a potato masher (or a fork) until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice the chicken crosswise on an angle.
To serve, place the mashed potatoes, sautéed peas, and chicken on a plate. Garnish with the lemon wedges and enjoy!
This recipe will make about 6 cups of pudding. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Roughly chop frozen cherries. Place about ¼ of the chopped cherries in a small bowl or container, cover, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Place remaining cherries in a blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cup frozen cherries

instructions.primary_message: Add milk, sugar, maple syrup, vanilla, and cardamom to the blender. Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) almond milk, unsweetened
½ cup granulated sugar
⅓ cup pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract
½ tsp cardamom, ground

instructions.primary_message: Pour the cherry mixture into a large bowl, add chia seeds, and whisk to combine. Let the mixture rest, whisking occasionally, until chia seeds start to swell, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup chia seeds

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place cocoa powder, maple syrup, water, tahini, vanilla, and salt in a small saucepan. Cook over low heat, whisking constantly, until sauce is combined and thickened, 3-4 minutes. Pour into another small bowl or container, cover, and place in the fridge.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup cocoa powder
½ cup pure maple syrup
4 ½ fl oz water
3 tbsp tahini
¾ tsp vanilla extract
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: When the chia seeds are slightly swollen, whisk the pudding once more to separate any seeds that are clumped together. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a lid and refrigerate until set, about 2 hours (or overnight).
To serve, divide chia seed pudding between small bowls or cups; top with chocolate-tahini sauce and reserved cherries. Enjoy!
Wash, dry, and quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pit. Medium dice the flesh and place in a medium saucepan.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 peaches

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and add blueberries to the saucepan with the peaches.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) pkgs blueberries

instructions.primary_message: Add water, sugar, and vanilla to the saucepan, then stir to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, stirring the fruit occasionally.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 fl oz (⅜ cup) water
⅓ cup granulated sugar
2 tbsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Once the fruit mixture is simmering, reduce heat to medium. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the fruit is soft, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water and cornstarch until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fl oz (¾ cup) water
3 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: When the fruit is soft, add cornstarch slurry to the saucepan in a steady stream, stirring constantly. Return mixture to a simmer and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, about 4 minutes.
Remove sauce from heat and transfer to a heatproof bowl. Place in the fridge to cool, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place almonds in a skillet. Set over medium heat and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted, about 4 minutes. Transfer to another small bowl and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place one scoop of ice cream in the bottom of each bowl; top with half of the blueberry-peach sauce. Place a second scoop of ice cream on top, drizzle with remaining sauce, and sprinkle with toasted almonds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) vanilla ice cream, vegan

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Divide tortillas between two large baking sheet pans. Drizzle with oil on both sides, then season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 small corn tortillas
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until tortillas are golden and crispy, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
12 eggs
¾ tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the eggs are cooking, wash, dry, and small dice tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide crispy tortillas between plates; top with eggs, tomatoes, and avocado. Drizzle with hot sauce and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a large bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, basil, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp basil, dried
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; place in the reserved bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into the bowl with the chickpeas, then add nutritional yeast, tahini, oil, and spices. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup nutritional yeast flakes
⅓ cup tahini
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve olives lengthwise.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Divide pitas between two baking sheet pans; evenly top with chickpea spread, then veggies and olives.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain pitas

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until pitas are warmed through, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pita wedges between plates. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Divide tortillas between two additional baking sheets. Drizzle with oil on both sides, then season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 small corn tortillas
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place tortillas in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until starting to crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Crumble tofu into large pieces with your fingers and add to the pot along with spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is golden brown, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the tofu is cooking, wash, dry, and medium dice tomatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: When the tofu is done, remove from the heat. Add tomatoes, parsley, and olives, then stir to combine the scramble.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates and top with tofu scramble. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Melt oil in a large pot set over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts. Place in a medium bowl along with flour, sugar, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup walnuts
1 cup all-purpose flour
⅓ cup granulated sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the oil is melted, drizzle into the bowl with the flour. Use a fork to stir and combine the streusel topping into rough, sandy clumps (it should be combined but not even). (Reserve pot for later use.)

Transfer streusel mixture to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until streusel is golden brown and crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
While the streusel is baking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 (6 oz) pkgs raspberries
3 (6 oz) pkgs blackberries

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium heat. Juice limes into the pot, then add raspberries, blackberries, and additional sugar. Cook, stirring occasionally, until berries are juicy and starting to break down, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide berries and ice cream between bowls; top with walnut streusel. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) vanilla ice cream, vegan

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 450°F and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.

Wash, peel, and medium dice the sweet potatoes; add to the water in the saucepan. Once the water is boiling, cook the potatoes until tender when pierced with a fork, 8-10 minutes. Drain in a colander and return back to saucepan.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash the broccoli and cut into bite-sized florets; transfer to the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 crowns broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Wash the lemons and grate the zest from them.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle the broccoli with olive oil and lemon juice and season with the zest, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and red pepper (optional). Toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
juice of 1 ½ lemon
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper (optional)

instructions.primary_message: Place broccoli in the oven and roast until tender and browned, 10-15 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the pork chops with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the pork chops and cook until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let them rest for 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the sweet potatoes and season with salt and pepper. Mash with a potato masher (or a fork) until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Serve pork chops with sweet potato mash and broccoli on the side. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core pears; medium dice.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 pears

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pears, water, sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the pears are golden and starting to soften, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp virgin coconut oil
3 fl oz (⅜ cup) water
2 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground
3 pinch nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oats, additional oil, flour, and sugar in a medium bowl. Using two hands, combine the topping by rubbing the mixture between your thumbs and fingers until it looks crumbly. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup oats, quick cooking
½ cup virgin coconut oil
⅓ cup all-purpose flour
¼ cup brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice bananas.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 bananas

instructions.primary_message: Transfer pears to a large baking dish and spread out in an even layer. Arrange banana slices on top, then sprinkle evenly with topping.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until fruit is soft and topping is golden, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide crisp and ice cream between bowls. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) vanilla ice cream, vegan

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, roughly chop walnuts.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 cup walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add walnuts and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash and large dice eggplant. Transfer to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with oregano, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplant
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and, stirring halfway though, bake until softened and browned, about 20 minutes.
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
18 oz (1 quarter coin = 2 oz) linguine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and mince onion and garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
9 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic and pepper to pan. Stir until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, vinegar, sugar, spices, and ½ of the basil (save the rest for garnishing). Cook for 4-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
1 ½ tsp white wine vinegar
3 pinch brown sugar
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta and add to pan with tomatoes. Add eggplant and toss to combine.
To serve, place pasta in a shallow bowl or on a plate and garnish with remaining basil. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 medium carrots
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice potatoes.
Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince onions; peel, trim, and small dice carrots.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the onion and carrot. Cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

When the veggies are soft, add veggie ground to the skillet, along with half of the parsley and spices (reserving remaining parsley for garnish). Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until crumbly and cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggie ground is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high.
Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the veggie ground is done, add garlic and soy sauce to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Add flour and tomato paste to the skillet; stir well, then add broth, peas, and corn. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
3 tbsp tomato paste
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ cup frozen peas
¾ cup frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, drain and return to the pot. Add broth, oil, garlic powder, and salt; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fl oz (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the veggie ground mixture to a large baking dish and spread evenly; top with mashed potatoes. Place in the oven and broil for 2-3 minutes, until the potatoes begin to brown.
To serve, divide the Shepherd's pie between plates and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!
